full_name: Intisar A. Rabb | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 Law Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor Harvard University
bio: While we know much about the jurists who operated in early Islamic law, we know less about the judges and those whose problems they addressed. Intisar A. Rabb seeks to investigate early Islamic courts and the people and procedures operating in them.
